name: bambustudio
summary: [Bambu Studio](https://bambulab.com/en/download/studio) is an open-source, cutting-edge, feature-rich slicing software. It contains project-based workflows, systematically optimized slicing algorithms, and an easy-to-use graphical interface, bringing users an incredibly smooth printing experience.

ports.description: Bambu Studio desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

volumes.description: Users home directory in the container, stores program settings and files.

env.name: DARK_MODE
env.description: Set this to true to enable dark mode for Bambu Studio.

docs.setup:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

changelog.text: Ingest from pre-release, make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Rebase to Ubuntu Noble to ingest approved appimage.
Rebase to Selkies, HTTPS IS NOW REQUIRED.
Add required fonts and environment variable for dark mode.
Update Readme with new env vars.
Fix printer camera by ingesting Fedora Appimage, Add program icon for PWA ingestion.
